other_failure_modes.name: Target Leakage in Meta-Feature Generation
other_failure_modes.description: When generating meta-features (such as predictions from a base model) to be used as inputs for another model, using in-sample predictions on the training set causes target leakage. The downstream model will overfit to this meta-feature because it is unrealistically accurate on the training data.

summary: The agent implements a comprehensive pipeline with TF-IDF, target encoding, and an ensemble of tree models. However, it introduces critical data leakage by fitting TF-IDF and SVD on the combined train and test sets before cross-validation. Additionally, there is severe target leakage in the meta-feature generation, where in-sample predictions from a Ridge regression model are used as training features for the downstream tree models.
